build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with config, task, model, and criterion for distributed data parallel training across GPUs
train_step_Trainer: run a training step with forward pass, backward pass, and parameter update using the Trainer class
save_checkpoint_Trainer: save all training state including model, optimizer, and lr scheduler to a checkpoint file
load_checkpoint_Trainer: load training state from a checkpoint file and restore model, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
clip_grad_norm_Trainer: clip the gradient norms of the model parameters using the Trainer clip_grad_norm method
